description: This file manages workspace packages, including versioning, consistency checks, and package file operations for a monorepo setup. It defines classes for packages and workspace operations, and includes CLI command handling.

classes.name: PWPackage
classes.description: Represents a package within the workspace, holding its metadata and file list.

classes.name: Workspace
classes.description: Manages the collection of packages, versioning, and consistency operations for the monorepo.

methods.name: readJSON
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and parses a JSON file.

methods.name: writeJSON
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a JSON object to a file.

methods.name: PWPackage.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a package with its descriptor info.

methods.name: Workspace.packages
methods.description: Returns the list of packages in the workspace.

methods.name: Workspace.version
methods.description: Retrieves the current workspace version from package.json.

methods.name: Workspace.setVersion
methods.description: Sets a new version for the workspace and updates all packages accordingly.

methods.name: Workspace.ensureConsistent
methods.description: Ensures package.json and package-lock.json are consistent with the workspace version.
